resources.string: ARC Screen Vision reads on-screen text, skips YouTube ads, controls reels/videos, translates screen content, and auto-fills forms only when you command ARC.
Allows ARC to lock your screen immediately when you speak a lock command (force-lock only).
Allows ARC to read notifications aloud from apps you explicitly enable in Settings.
ARC is listening continuously. Tap Mute / Mic OFF in ARC anytime to stop.
